tex_content.html:
Proposition
↗ UNRESOLVED:chB:12.32 1. chB:B.9

Suppose $M$ is a smooth manifold, $X \in \mathfrak {X}(M)$, and $A$ is a smooth covariant $k$-tensor field on $M$. For all smooth vector fields $Z_1, \ldots , Z_k$: \[ (\mathscr {L}_X A)(Z_1, \ldots , Z_k) = X(A(Z_1, \ldots , Z_k)) - A(\mathscr {L}_X Z_1, Z_2, \ldots , Z_k) - A(Z_1, \mathscr {L}_X Z_2, \ldots , Z_k) - \cdots - A(Z_1, \ldots , \mathscr {L}_X Z_k). \]

As we did for vector fields, we say that a covariant tensor field $A$ is invariant under a flow $\theta $ if $(\theta _t)^* A = A$ wherever it is defined. The next proposition is a tensor analog of Proposition A.47.
